p.bio: Hi my name eston dubel i'm seychellois sailor at the age of 13 sailing instructor windsurfing instructor now doing sail repair work sail far east 28 won manny natoinals during my younger days still enjoying a good breeze and verry happy to be in the SLL gold cup team representing sechelles.By the way i was one of first among 4 seychellois to teach sailing for the first time in my country and i'm very proud to see how far we've been thanks
